verdicts.reason: A scrambles the reading order: "Xavier Sport Program" sits above "by submitting to", so the sentence reads backwards. The blue box is jammed against the top edge, it covers the racket and the top of the ball, and the text sizes are inconsistent and cramped. The dividers and the thin frame are lost. B keeps the correct order (Win a study grant / by submitting to / Xavier Sport Program) in a clean blue panel with the ball and racket visible above it. Its flaws are tiny, hard-to-read secondary text, "Program" orphaned on its own line, a two-column split inside the panel that feels odd, and a panel that crowds the ball and sits low against the bottom edge. It is still the more coherent and brand-faithful layout.
